wasteland/button.prompt:
A UI button of the button of the wasteland UI style for a survival and extraction game of scavenged stashes, crafting and radiation: its border and face, its centre plain so a label reads on it.
Style: Cinematic realism. Believable materials, human proportions and natural light, organised by cinematic framing, depth and colour control. Physically based materials, natural light, film-like grading and lenses, composition from cinema.
Palette: free, graded; one grade per area; avoid oversaturation; skin tones protected.
Nine-slice: the corners (23% left, 32% top, 23% right, 32% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: none, no outline.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: flat ambient light; saturated game-y colours; stylised outlines; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single button only, centred, filling the image across its width, 2.18 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 44 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A secondary button: a raised slab of dark weathered steel (#34302a) with a 2 px rust-brown bevelled edge (#6a4428), lighter scratched top edge and a darker bottom edge, small worn chips at its corners; the label area plain so light text reads on it. Hovered: one step lighter. Square corners with a 2 px chip; no rivets, no tape, no stripes. As the inactive tabs and keys of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
